audience: teams that check US business entities against Secretary of State records

useCases.title: Find a business record by its name
useCases.text: List the states Cobalt can search, then search one state for a business name. Read the record of the match you pick.

useCases.title: Read a business by its filing id
useCases.text: Use the Secretary of State filing id from a search or an earlier record to read that business in one state.

useCases.title: Check a slow business search
useCases.text: A slow search returns a retry id. Check it with that id, and check again later if the status is still incomplete.

useCases.title: Narrow a common business name by city or zip
useCases.text: Read a business record in one state. Add a city or zip code to narrow a common name to one record.
